glosses: attack (an attempt to cause damage, injury to, or death of an opponent or enemy)
attack (an attempt to detract from the worth or credibility of someone or something)
attack (the sudden onset of a disease or condition)

examples.text: A melhor defesa é o ataque.
examples.en: Attack is the best form of defense.

examples.text: Tom morreu de ataque no coração.
examples.en: Tom died of a heart attack.

examples.text: Quase tive um ataque do coração.
examples.en: I nearly had a heart attack.

examples.text: Tom teve um ataque de pânico.
